_source: Copied from bina-start-school/config/calendar-2026-27.json (transcribed 2026-09-14 from the printed 2026/27 bina calendar) + config/enrollment.json. Provisional: replace with the school team's final list when it lands.
_openQuestions: EXTRA NOV+ INTAKE DATES (head of school, 2026-10-07): more start dates for November onward are coming the week of 2026-10-12. Until then only biome starts show after October.
PROVISIONAL DATES (Akis, 2026-10-05): the school team is preparing the final start-date list. When it lands, put it in startDates.override and drop the noindex + robots.txt block.
Wed 10 Mar 2027 non-school day inside Rainforest: 'still being confirmed with the school' (Akis quick guide, 2026-09-15).

nonSchoolDays.note: No-school day inside Rainforest (uncoloured on the printed calendar).

startDates._rules: Slack #strategy 2026-09-14 (confirmed by Juli) and #admissions-team 2026-09-15. A Wednesday is a start date only if: 1) inside a biome (no breaks), 2) not a non-school day, 3) not the biome's last day, 4) not the last remaining Wednesday of the biome. Plus each biome's first day (a Monday).
startDates._rollingUntil: Head of school, 2026-10-07: rolling admissions continue through October; from November new children start only on biome start dates. More November-onward dates coming the following week — add them to override when they land.
startDates._signBy: Fixed rule (Akis, 2026-10-05): Family Success needs at least 3 business days to onboard, for every start date including biome-start Mondays. Wednesday → sign by the Friday before; Monday → sign by the Wednesday before. Same rule as bina-start-school config/enrollment.json (cutoffBusinessDays).
